title: Experience Helicopter Attractions of Los Angeles
blurb:
Experience the ultimate helicopter adventure above the stunning attractions of Los Angeles! Our most popular tour takes you on an unforgettable journey, providing intimate aerial views of some of the city's most iconic sights. Buckle up and prepare to be amazed as we whisk you over exclusive celebrity homes in Beverly Hills, allowing you a glimpse into the lives of the rich and famous.

Would highly recommend to anyone, especially anyone short on time but that wants to see everything !!!!
